layout.footer: This email was sent automatically by Platform. Please do not reply.
auth.welcome.subject: Welcome to Platform
auth.welcome.preview: Your account is ready. Let's build your first website.
auth.welcome.body: Welcome to Platform! Your account is ready. Start from a template, build on the canvas yourself, or let the AI assistant help you create your first website.
auth.account_exists.subject: You already have a Platform account
auth.account_exists.preview: Someone tried to sign up with your email.
auth.account_exists.body: Someone (maybe you) tried to sign up for Platform with this email address. It is already registered, so no new account was created.
auth.account_exists.forgot: Forgot your password? Reset it here.
auth.account_exists.ignore: If you did not try to sign up, you can ignore this email. Your account is still safe.
auth.verify_email.subject: Verify your email
auth.verify_email.body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you so you can publish websites. The link is valid for 24 hours.
auth.verify_email.code: Or enter this code on the verification page:
auth.verify_email.ignore: If you did not create a Platform account, you can ignore this email.
auth.verify_email.change_body: Click the button below to use this address as your Platform account email. Until you confirm, your old email stays active. The link is valid for 24 hours.
auth.password_reset.subject: Reset your password
auth.password_reset.preview: The password reset link is valid for 1 hour.
auth.password_reset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Platform account. The link is valid for 1 hour and can only be used once.
auth.password_reset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.
auth.password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
auth.password_changed.preview: The password for your Platform account was just changed.
auth.password_changed.body: The password for your Platform account was just changed. For your security, all other sessions have been signed out.
auth.password_changed.warning: Didn't change it? Reset your password right away.
